Anya (marketing): Quick sync — planning the seed->product-demo routing experiment for the mini-launch next week. Goal: measure conversion lift from free credits + targeted demo invites. Thoughts?
Priya (content): Love it. Suggest two copy variants: "Curated demo" vs "Hands-on invite". Keep landing simple.
Mateo (growth): We should gate invites to accounts with >3 API requests in 24h; that signals intent. Also add UTM so we can attribute.
Devin (analytics): We can track with experiment_id=seed_demo_v1. Proposed metrics: 7-day demo-book rate, activation (first 5 requests) and post-demo retention. I'll set up funnel.
Sam (sales): Can we auto-create a lead in Outreach for demo clicks? If so, I'll follow up within 24h.
launch-bot: Reminder: content freeze in 48h for launch posts. https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-ops :bell:
Anya (marketing): Mateo + Devin — please add rule + experiment config here so ops team can implement:
```
rule: credits_used >= 1 AND requests_last_24h >= 3
action_variants: invite_demo_email | invite_demo_in_app | control
holdback: 10%
experiment_id: seed_demo_v1
start_ts: 1718200000
````
Mateo (growth): adding small holdback: 10% control (no invite). Should help measure lift.
Devin (analytics): ack — I'll send cohort spec into GA and spin up a Looker dashboard. Need event list from product (demo_click, demo_book, first_5_requests).
Priya (content): Will prepare two subject lines + 2 micro-copy variants and drop in #marketing-assets by EOD.
Sam (sales): If Outreach hook is possible, prefer tagging leads as "warm" for credits >= 5. I'll provide follow-up template.
Anya (marketing): Quick checklist: 1) routing rule in prod (Mateo), 2) email + in-app copy (Priya), 3) analytics dashboard (Devin), 4) sales hook (Sam). Status updates here pls :pray:
Mateo (growth): Routing PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/542 — cc @devs for review.
Devin (analytics): Dashboard skeleton done; will populate when events arrive. Adding CI for uplift estimates.
Priya (content): Assets uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/seed-demo-assets — filenames: demo_email_A.txt, demo_email_B.txt, inapp_cards_v1.png
Anya (marketing): Nice — final ask: can we draft one-line benchmark for launch post that sets expectations? e.g. "Target +15% demo-book vs control" — anyone want to edit?
Sam (sales): +1. Suggest "+18% for credits>=5 cohort" if we segment.
Devin (analytics): Conservative bound +12-15% with 10% holdback. I'll add CI bands to the dashboard.
Anya (marketing): Great. I'll post the launch thread and schedule a 15-min post-launch sync 3 days after start. Thanks all :rocket:
